[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/google-play-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/google-play-scraper.md)

示例爬虫，用于收集来自 play.google.com（Google Play 商店）的应用数据，使用 Python 和 [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) 网页抓取 API 编写。属于 [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.zh-CN.md) 项目。

- **指南:** [How to Scrape Google Play App Reviews and Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-google-play-app-reviews-and-data)
- **代码:** [`google_play.py`](google_play.py) · **示例运行:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **测试:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **示例输出:** [App](results/app.json) · [Reviews](results/reviews.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## 抓取内容

- Google Play 应用详情页面，获取应用数据
- Google Play 应用评价
- Google Play 搜索页面，获取应用列表数据

## 函数

- `scrape_apps(app_ids, lang='en', country='us')` → `List[Dict]`: scrape Google Play app detail pages
- `scrape_reviews(app_id, lang='en', country='us', sort=Sort.NEWEST, max_reviews=100, filter_score_with=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape app reviews via the Play Store batchexecute endpoint
- `scrape_search(query, lang='en', country='us')` → `List[Dict]`: scrape Google Play search results

这些函数是 `async` 函数：请使用 `asyncio.run(...)` 运行，或使用 `await` 调用。

### 示例

输入参数取自 [`run.py`](run.py) 中的示例（较长的列表已截短）：

```python
import asyncio
import google_play


async def main():
    apps = await google_play.scrape_apps(app_ids=["com.whatsapp", "com.spotify.music"])
    reviews = await google_play.scrape_reviews(app_id="com.whatsapp", max_reviews=100)
    search = await google_play.scrape_search(query="Music")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## 输出

这些函数返回普通的字典和列表。示例输出的字段（第一项的顶层键）：

- [`results/app.json`](results/app.json): `title`, `description`, `descriptionHTML`, `summary`, `installs`, `minInstalls`, `realInstalls`, `score`, `ratings`, `reviews`, `histogram`, `price`, `free`, `currency`, `offersIAP`, `inAppProductPrice`, `developer`, `developerId`, `developerEmail`, `developerWebsite`, `developerAddress`, `privacyPolicy`, `genre`, `genreId`, `categories`, `icon`, `headerImage`, `screenshots`, `video`, `videoImage`, `contentRating`, `contentRatingDescription`, `adSupported`, `containsAds`, `released`, `lastUpdatedOn`, `updated`, `version`, `comments`, `appId`, … (1 更多)
- [`results/reviews.json`](results/reviews.json): `reviewId`, `userName`, `userImage`, `content`, `score`, `thumbsUpCount`, `reviewCreatedVersion`, `at`, `replyContent`, `repliedAt`, `appVersion`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `appId`, `icon`, `screenshots`, `title`, `score`, `genre`, `price`, `free`, `currency`, `video`, `videoImage`, `description`, `descriptionHTML`, `developer`, `installs`

## Scrapfly 设置

[`google_play.py`](google_play.py) 中的 `BASE_CONFIG` 保存请求的默认设置，参见 [Scrape API 文档](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started)：

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly 的 [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)，即其反机器人绕过功能
- `country` = `"US"`: 代理所在国家

## 快速开始

需要 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation)。

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/google-play-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # 获取地址： https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # 示例抓取，结果保存在 ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # 运行该爬虫的测试
```

测试：`test_app_scraping`, `test_reviews_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`；使用 `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>` 运行单个测试。 `run.py` 和测试会抓取真实网站，因此会消耗 Scrapfly 积分。
